title: ACDelco PF64 Engine Oil Filter

comparisons.notes: PF64, SKU 527737. Public product page retrieved October 30 displayed $10.99 and Add to Cart; store-level inventory depends on location.

writeup: For a vehicle that calls for this exact filter, Woot’s $2.99 offers a low-cost way to prepare for a future oil change. AutoZone’s public PF64 listing showed $10.99 when checked, making the item price 72% lower. Fitment is the deciding factor here: confirm the PF64 specification for your vehicle rather than buying solely on price.
notes: One filter, new condition; Woot limits the offer to three per customer and lists a 90-day warranty. AutoZone’s price came from its search-accessible product page, not a completed local-store availability check. Lower listings at AutoBuffy and FinditParts were excluded because their live pages said out of stock. Check current part-number supersessions and vehicle fitment with the retailer.
amazon_match_notes: ACDelco PF64, single filter; confirm vehicle fitment.
